actual_source_architecture.mechanism: TabPFN-derived linear attention computes K^T V and a key-sum normalizer, not an N×N softmax attention matrix. Training rows self-attend within support; query rows attend only support; query labels are zero placeholders.
actual_source_architecture.implementation: Pure torch einsum/projections/LayerNorm/FFN; selected linear-attention branch contains no required CUDA-specific attention kernel. The source feature_map values identity and elu both select ELU+1; identity_for_real is a different branch. Encoder replaces NaNs by zero after preprocessing.
actual_source_architecture.checkpoint_limit: Actual layer count/embedding size/feature-map config/head count/parameter count not established without checkpoint metadata. Filename nsamples50000 or epoch110 does not establish total training duration or prove delivered architecture parameters.
actual_source_architecture.different_from_tested: A genuinely different linear-attention aggregation from evaluated quadratic-attention PFNs; being built on TabPFN code does not make it the same learned weights. No accuracy advantage inferred from scalability.

official_routing.behavior: TabFlex.__init__ fetches three files, creates three classifier objects; fit selects exactly one according to row/feature counts. It does not average their predictions.
official_routing.selector: N>=3000 and D<=100 -> L100; otherwise higher-dimensional cases -> H1K; small cases -> S100.
official_routing.this_task: 4636 and8693 supports with13numeric-encoded columns,2classes -> L100; no feature projection needed if delivered config agrees.
official_routing.support_limit: TabPFNClassifier default max_num_train_samples=np.inf and wrapper fit passes overwrite_warning=True. No support truncation occurs in inspected default route;8693 is supported by API logic, not yet by measured resources.

fixed_recipe_if_reachable.input: same13semantic fields, numeric representation with train-only category mapping; mapping is a local adapter, not a claimed author-provided categorical encoder. Preserve NaNs until official preprocessing.
fixed_recipe_if_reachable.probability_api: Selected underlying TabPFNClassifier.predict_proba; top-level TabFlex exposes only predict.
fixed_recipe_if_reachable.device_adapter: Select exact official L100 classifier with device=cpu for initial reference rather than instantiate CUDA-only wrapper/all3 downloads. Any later MPS device adaptation must preserve math and be disclosed.

preprocessing_findings: Default mix enumerates none then power_all per permutation; L1001view selects the first none configuration. It still performs support-only mean/std normalization, support-only constant-column selection, outlier treatment and used-feature scaling, then zero-padding according to config (expected100, not verified).
transformer_predict slices eval_ys to support before preprocessing; constant-column check therefore uses support, not query. normalize_with_test defaultsFalse.
Temperature is hardcoded0.8 in transformer_predict regardless of passed value; keep exact official behavior, no threshold or temperature tuning.
String categorical data need external numeric coding; official check_array/model do not implement a train-only string vocabulary. Unknown/missing handling must be frozen in any adapter.
platform_risks: Top-level TabFlex hardcodes device=cuda for all3 models, so it is not directly MPS-ready. Underlying classifier has CPU path.
Non-CPU inference enters torch.cuda.amp.autocast, which does not establish a valid MPS mixed-precision policy. First comparison should use FP32 CPU and FP32 MPS, not silently substitute bf16.

get_linear_attention_layers probes torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported when dtype absent, but resulting dtype variable is not passed to constructed layers in the inspected branch; still needs a CPU import/constructor check.

Old sklearn force_all_finite API and model-builder imports may require isolated compatible dependencies. load_model explicitly uses weights_only=False to read config and official backward-compatible key renaming, then load_state_dict strict=True. Do not use strict=False or guess architecture.
Linear memory scaling is promising but not a measured16GB bound. Avoid author millions-of-rows benchmark as proof for this device/dataset.
next_gate: Only if root independently verifies this exact official endpoint: record bytes, SHA256, source pin and delivered config; do not search third-party replacement weights in this task.
CPU strict-load exact official builder + small synthetic full-context reference; verify same probability on reordered/rebatched queries and portable reload; no labels or scores needed.

If CPU works, separately authorize MPS same-FP32 small comparison, then4636/8693 full support with2318/4277queries, unchanged context and query-batch invariance. No fallback truncation, hidden three-weight averaging or recipe search.
